- **Fair comparison:** one dataset per timeframe and month for every configuration that ran on it: M1 W5 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M15 W1 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M15 W2 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M15 W3 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M15 W4 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M15 W5 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M15 W6 42 configurations / 1 dataset; M5 W1 565 configurations / 1 dataset; M5 W2 565 configurations / 1 dataset; M5 W3 565 configurations / 1 dataset; M5 W4 565 configurations / 1 dataset; M5 W5 565 configurations / 1 dataset; M5 W6 565 configurations / 1 dataset.
- **No hold-out leakage:** every development choice recomputed with all hold-out rows removed is identical: A yes, B yes, C yes, R1 yes, R2 yes, R3 yes, R4 yes, R5 yes, R6 yes, R7 yes, R8 yes, R9 yes.
